caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden bucket, which appears to be made of vertical staves bound together by two horizontal green bands, one near the top and one near the bottom. The staves of the bucket are colored in various shades of brown, suggesting the natural grain of wood. The two green bands encircle the body of the bucket and seem to be made of metal. The bucket has a handle consisting of a thin, curved metal wire attached to either side, with a centrally placed wooden grip colored in a slightly lighter brown than the bucket itself. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or decoration. There is some faint text and markings along the bottom of the drawing and a signature to the right of the bucket.
title: Shaker Cedar Bucket
